status: frozen proof contract, 16 September 2026; actual evaluated bounds in astra-scene/measured-bounds.json

axes.blender: X right, Y back, Z up; front = -Y
axes.gltf: X right, Y up, Z front; Blender export converts (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y)

building.courtyard: open front court plus recessed central court; avoid monolithic box

composition.comment: Irregular coast with terraced rear and rocky foreground; cove and bridge clear of worker court. Small far landing is scenery, not another project.

worker.requirement: reuse existing worker source/type; no worker instances baked into scene

materialRoles.structure: warm ivory ceramic/paint with recesses, dark joints, wear and real PBR detail
materialRoles.ground: varied rock, soil, short ground cover; no smooth green carpet
materialRoles.practical: material names prefixed practical_; runtime controls emissive intensity
materialRoles.taskStatus: runtime only; no task progress or fixture identity in scenery

metadata: Must contain actual exported camera, socket, bounds and shorelineXZ coordinates, material and named group inventory. Builder updates this shared contract if composition adjustments are agreed.
portableMaterials: GLB PBR with embedded color/roughness/normal textures as needed. No Cycles holdouts, lights baked into base color, or unexported procedural detail.

ownership.builder: shared contract, app, public assets, tests, evidence and integration

shoreline: Two explicitly closed runtime loops (83 and 14 points), simplified from exact exported sections with maximum error 0.1393 metres. Exact loops and measured deviations retained in scene-metadata.json.
